Before drafting formal reprimands and bonus forfeiture notices, specific factual and contractual records are required. 

Formal disciplinary and compensation actions depend on documented policies, contractual terms, and verified facts. The current request lacks the necessary factual basis:

1. **Established facts vs. unknowns:**
   - *Reported:* Four engineers left a retreat, and a manager named Keller requested formal reprimands and bonus forfeitures before Monday.
   - *Unknowns:* The specific dates, times, and circumstances of the departure; whether attendance at the retreat was mandatory under employment agreements or company policy; whether the departure violated an explicit policy; whether the bonus plan is discretionary or governed by contractual metrics; and whether bonus forfeiture complies with governing labor regulations and plan documentation.

2. **Risks and constraints:**
   - Issuing disciplinary letters without citing specific dates, documented directives, and violated policy sections creates legal and procedural exposure.
   - Bonus forfeiture without reference to the specific terms of the bonus agreement (or where state/local labor law restricts retroactively altering earned incentive pay) carries regulatory and litigation risks.

3. **Required verification:**
   To draft legally and procedurally sound documents, provide the following data points:
   - The applicable employee handbook policies or written retreat instructions regarding attendance.
   - The specific bonus plan terms regarding forfeiture conditions.
   - The factual record for each individual (names, job titles, exact dates/times of departure, and whether permission was sought or granted).

### Compliant Template Options

If you need working drafts immediately, use the standard factual templates below, filling in only verified policy citations and documented timelines.

#### Option A: Written Reprimand Draft
```text
TO: [Employee Name], [Title]
FROM: [Manager Name/HR], [Title]
DATE: [Date]
SUBJECT: Formal Written Reprimand: Unauthorized Absence from [Event Name]

On [Date], you departed the mandatory company retreat located at [Location] at approximately [Time] without prior authorization from your manager, [Manager Name].

Under [Company Name] Policy [Section Number, e.g., Code of Conduct / Attendance Policy], all employees are required to [quote applicable standard, e.g., attend scheduled company functions and obtain advance written approval for departures during business hours]. 

Your early departure constitutes a violation of this policy. 

Corrective Action Required:
1. Maintain adherence to all scheduled working hours and required company events.
2. Follow standard notification procedures for any future absence.

Failure to meet standard conduct expectations may result in further disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.

Employee Acknowledgment of Receipt:
Signature: ______________________ Date: ______________
```

#### Option B: Notice of Bonus Ineligibility / Forfeiture
```text
TO: [Employee Name], [Title]
FROM: [HR/Compensation Committee]
DATE: [Date]
SUBJECT: Notification Regarding Bonus Eligibility: [Performance Period / Plan Name]

This memorandum notifies you of a determination regarding your bonus under the [Specific Plan Name, e.g., 2026 Annual Incentive Plan].

Pursuant to Section [Number] of the [Plan Name], eligibility for incentive awards is contingent upon [cite specific rule, e.g., active employment in good standing / absence of formal disciplinary actions / discretionary approval by executive leadership]. 

Due to [reference specific documented event, e.g., the formal disciplinary action issued on Date regarding the unauthorized departure from the retreat on Date], you do not meet the criteria for award distribution for [specified period]. Consequently, [describe action precisely: e.g., an award will not be issued / the award amount has been reduced to $0.00].

If you have questions regarding the governing plan documentation, contact [HR Contact / Email].

Authorized Signature: ______________________ Date: ______________
```

### Next Action
Verify the exact language of the governing bonus plan and obtain the documented timeline of the retreat departure before populating these templates and delivering them to Keller.
